rule: ACG-style enzyme elevation: first ALT or AST >=2xULN (ULN=40)
ACG enzyme >=2xULN AND first TBil >1.2 mg/dL (>=20 umol/L)
APASL lab gate only: first TBil >=5 mg/dL AND first INR >=1.5
EASL/DILI lab gate: first ALT >=5xULN OR ALP >=2xULN (ULN ALT40/ALP115)
Hy's-law lab pattern: (ALT or AST >=3xULN) AND first TBil >=2xULN (>=34 umol/L)
MARS early hyperbilirubinemia: TBil >=33 umol/L within first 48 h
SOFA liver item >=2 (first TBil >=33 umol/L) [current main]
